author: Zintenka
body:
Me and Junr actually made this map a month ago but I didn't upload or do the XML yet because I'm a lazy cunt - anyway, here's the map. I've made sure to go extra hard on the features and stuff in the XML - the neato features were improvised by me and Junr The Goof ;)



Wool + Wool Cap Zone



Monument


Features:
  • Quartz, quartz-related blocks, signs, ladders, wool, buttons and stained glass cannot be broken.
  • Defenders cannot place TNT by their monument but may ACTIVATE or BREAK TNT.
  • Cannot place TNT in wool towers - no exceptions!
  • DTM/CTW
  • Defenders will be able to go into wool tower but cannot go into the Attacker's level. They must defend the teleporter pad from attackers.
  • Wool is automatically given via teleporter pad; attackers must fight their way through enemies again.
Loadout 

Wool supplies - Iron pickaxe also has +6 attack damage




XML
DOWNLOAD
IMGUR

I hope you guys enjoy this map! :D

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Players spawn on this platform.


They build forward... they can either go to the monument to defend (Cannot place TNT but can activate and break TNT)


Go to the center to attack enemy objectives


Or go above to defend wool room (Defenders can enter tower but must guard teleporter pad, the "gate" in front of the wool room is where wool dudes go to capture the wool)


You cannot break ladders, signs, quartz or buttons on this map. Also, red glass walls mean that you can't build against those walls whilst green glass walls mean that you can build against those walls.

The XML was a bitch and a half to do xD
